concept.title: Rich Text
concept.shortdesc: If a rich text field has been included in a list, it will display as either Click here to Add or Click here to Edit depending on whether that field already has data or not. When you click on a rich text field, it will launch a side window that can be used to add or edit rich text. When you have completed the rich text modifications for a record, click Save to Excel. When you are done with all other changes to this or other records, then use the menu button provided in the template to save the data to Salesforce.
